commands.name: co-review-named-tests
commands.run: cd claude/skills/co-review/scripts && out=$(python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -k test_light_class_over_code_diff_is_incomplete -k test_light_seats_need_one_claude_and_one_codex_runtime -k test_light_recompute_uses_digest_bound_diff -k test_light_report_over_markdown_diff_approves -k test_class_mismatch_and_missing_class_are_incomplete -k test_seat_set_must_match_class -k test_audit_comment_renders_every_field_once -k test_audit_comment_refuses_non_approval -k test_both_entrypoints_pin_the_frozen_diff_and_class -k test_both_entrypoints_name_the_light_seats -k test_mirror_launches_light_verifier_through_claude_runner -k test_policy_describes_both_tiers -k test_ship_has_the_audit_comment_step -k test_rename_quoted_and_empty_are_unparseable -k test_code_and_gate_paths_are_full 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -5; [ "$rc" = 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -qx 'Ran 15 tests in [0-9.]*s'

commands.name: classify-cli-light
commands.run:
printf 'diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
+x
diff --git a/docs/a b.md b/docs/a b.md
+y
' | python3 claude/skills/co-review/scripts/gate_report.py classify --diff /dev/stdin | grep -qx light

commands.name: classify-cli-full
commands.run:
printf 'diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
+x
diff --git a/claude/hooks/x.py b/claude/hooks/x.py
+y
' | python3 claude/skills/co-review/scripts/gate_report.py classify --diff /dev/stdin | grep -qx full

commands.name: classify-cli-gate-skill
commands.run:
printf 'diff --git a/claude/skills/co-review/SKILL.md b/claude/skills/co-review/SKILL.md
+x
' | python3 claude/skills/co-review/scripts/gate_report.py classify --diff /dev/stdin | grep -qx full && printf 'diff --git a/old.md b/new.md
' | python3 claude/skills/co-review/scripts/gate_report.py classify --diff /dev/stdin | grep -qx full

commands.name: gate-schema-seat-sets
commands.run: python3 claude/skills/co-review/scripts/gate_report.py schema | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["light_seats"]==["codex","verifier"], d.get("light_seats"); assert d["full_seats"]==["claude","codex","breaker","verifier"]; assert d["report_example"]["class"]=="full" and d["expected_example"]["class"]=="full"; assert "required_seats" not in d'

commands.name: gate-policy-tiers
commands.run: p=$(python3 claude/skills/co-review/scripts/gate_report.py policy --section POLICY) && printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Fq 'light tier' && printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Fq 'full tier' && printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Fq '`codex` and `verifier`' && printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Fq 'change_class.py' && ! printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Fq 'All four seats'

commands.name: herdr-orch-suite-named
commands.run:
out=$(env -u WORKFLOW_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT -u HERDR_PERSONAL -u CLAUDE_PERSONAL_ONLY -u CLAUDE_WORK_TREE -u CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR -u CODEX_HOME -u XDG_STATE_HOME -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID sh claude/hooks/herdr-orch.test.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s
' "$out" | tail -3; [ "$rc" = 0 ] || exit 1; for l in 'wake_decision: every blocking Notification pushes' 'wake_decision: a record change 10 s after a push pushes' 'read_wake_marker: a v1 marker reads as empty; v2 keeps last_delivery' 'hook: a done.json change with no owner records last_delivery and stays unadvanced' 'deliver_wake: retries transient failures twice, never raises' 'wake_for_event: sent advances v2 records; failure keeps them and retries next call' 'wake_for_event: a v1 marker whose records match is ignored and rewritten as v2' 'watch: a think launch record and a write-task never signal; answers and done do' 'backstop_tick: undelivered signals at the grace; delivered never; stale marker values do not count' 'delivered_records: v2 only, keyed by file name, unreadable markers ignored' 'watch CLI: backstop flags validated' 'checkin: unreadable task and sidecar lines force changed: yes; missing sidecar is silent' 'checkin: wake= column from the marker, read-only' 'checkin: unverifiable review findings are reported, then clear on byte-identical restore' 'plan_record_matches: identity only, independent of artifacts' 'review-deadlines: ceil remaining from the review row; unknown without one'; do printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -Fqx "PASS  $l" || { echo "missing: $l"; exit 1; }; done; ! printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -Fq 'pushes once per transition into blocked'

commands.name: herdr-orch-contract-suite
commands.run: env -u WORKFLOW_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT -u HERDR_PERSONAL -u CLAUDE_PERSONAL_ONLY -u CLAUDE_WORK_TREE -u CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR -u CODEX_HOME -u XDG_STATE_HOME -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID sh claude/hooks/herdr-orch-contract.test.sh

commands.name: herdr-skill-text
commands.run: S=claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md; grep -Fq -- '--undelivered-only --exit-on-signal' $S && ! grep -Fq -- '--interval 60 --debounce-secs 300' $S && grep -Fq 'sleep 300' $S && grep -Fq 'review-deadlines' $S && grep -Fq 'sleep <remaining + 30>' $S && grep -Fq 'unverifiable-evidence' $S && grep -Fq 'dirty=yes' $S && grep -Fq 'Bash(gh pr merge:*)' $S && grep -Fq "--settings '{\"crossSessionInbound\":\"accept\"}'" $S && grep -Fq 'director` shell function' $S && ! grep -Fq 'both are watch wakes' $S && ! grep -Fq 'at the next heartbeat' $S && grep -Fq 'backstop' claude/agents/director.md && grep -Fq '`director`' claude/agents/director.md

commands.name: agent-runtime-named
commands.run: python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,"claude/hooks"); import agent_runtime as r; route=r.resolve_route("claude","reviewer",config={"provisional":True}); s={"personal_repository":False}; a=r.launch_argv(route,"/w/t","read-only",mode="interactive",scope=s); assert a[a.index("--permission-mode")+1]=="auto" and "plan" not in a, a; assert json.loads(a[a.index("--settings")+1])=={"permissions":{"deny":["Edit(//w/t/**)","Write(//w/t/**)"]}}, a; h=r.launch_argv(route,"/w/t","read-only",mode="headless",scope=s); assert h[h.index("--permission-mode")+1]=="plan", h; w=r.launch_argv(route,"/w/t","workspace-write",mode="interactive",scope=s); assert w[w.index("--permission-mode")+1]=="auto" and "--settings" not in w, w'

commands.name: herdr-dispatch-suite
commands.run: env -u WORKFLOW_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT -u HERDR_PERSONAL -u CLAUDE_PERSONAL_ONLY -u CLAUDE_WORK_TREE -u CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR -u CODEX_HOME -u XDG_STATE_HOME -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID bash claude/hooks/herdr-dispatch.test.sh
